fields.label: Project Cost Account
fields.description: Balance sheet account that holds a project's material (and optionally wage) costs until the final invoice, e.g. 201165 Project Expenses

fields.label: Cost of Sales Account
fields.description: Where the held costs are moved when the final invoice is submitted, e.g. 611115 Cost Of Sales - Projects

fields.label: Sales Account
fields.description: Income account for the final invoice, e.g. 501520 Sales - Projects

fields.label: Final Valuation Item
fields.description: Non-stock service item used for the single final valuation line
